title: Balak Enam
mood: comic and swaying, a sly village tall tale
subject: three men on the village ronda night-watch post who are meant to patrol and spend the night arguing over a game of gaple, while a chicken thief walks past behind them
caption: Campursari, the Central Javanese gamelan-and-keyboard style of the Didi Kempot era. Saron and demung playing the balungan melody, with kempul and a large gong marking the end of each phrase; a plucked siter zither rippling between vocal lines; kendhang ciblon driving a swaying dance groove; keroncong cak and cuk ukuleles strumming on the offbeats; soft keyboard string pads, a bass guitar and suling flute fills. Warm and roomy, the gamelan and the lead voice forward, the keyboard strings soft behind them. Warm male crooner singing in plain Indonesian with Javanese cengkok ornaments and a sly storytelling grin in the voice, a female sinden voice echoing short Javanese phrases in the chorus. 88 BPM, E minor. Comic and swaying, a sly village tall tale. No dangdut koplo beat, no rock drums, no EDM, no autotune, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - siter ripple, saron melody, one gong]

[Verse 1]
Malam Jumat, jadwal ronda kami bertiga
Pak Darno, Mas Joko, sama aku
Senter, sarung, kentongan di tiang
"Keliling nanti, habis satu putaran"

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu putaran jadi sebelas
Kuping Mas Joko penuh jepitan jemuran

[Chorus - the sinden echoes]
Gaple, gaple di pos ronda
Kartu dibanting, plak! sampai pagi
Kampung aman, katanya (jarene...)
Mata kami cuma ke meja

[Verse 2]
Di belakang lewat orang pakai sarung
Jalan pelan, pikul karung goni
Dari karungnya ada bunyi "petok"
Pak Darno bilang, "Sst! Aku lagi mikir"

[Chorus - the sinden echoes]
Gaple, gaple di pos ronda
Kartu dibanting, plak! sampai pagi
Ada yang lewat di belakang (liwat, liwat...)
Kami masih ribut soal balak enam

[Bridge - kendhang ciblon drops to a hush, then picks up]
Subuh-subuh Pak RT lari pakai singlet
"Jagoku hilang! Yang ronda ke mana?"
Kami bertiga angkat tangan, jepitan masih di kuping

[Chorus - the sinden echoes]
Gaple, gaple di pos ronda
Kartu dibanting, plak! sampai pagi
Kampung aman, katanya (jarene...)
Jago Pak RT udah sampai kampung sebelah

[Outro - siter and gong, the voice nearly alone]
Minggu depan kartunya disita (wis, wis...)
